description:
Goal

A captured callable transported as a first-class value remains on its public ABI when invoked, even when semantic resolution has one exact target. Native code must never expose the wrapper ValueRef word as the target private scalar.

Proven failure

On integration 19535a662, this source printed a callable and 42 in the backend interpreter but a callable and the tagged ValueRef word interpreted as an integer in JIT and AOT:

fn main() do
  n = 40
  f = fn (x) -> n + x end
  dbg(f)
  dbg(f.(2))
end

Exact first wrong transition

Upstream transport was coherent: TransportShape(Value(f)) had carrier ValueRef, the private lambda target returned RawInt, the public wrapper returned ValueRef, and the callsite ReturnPayload and ResumePayload were ValueRef. materialize_closure_call_edge ignored that carrier when CallSiteSummary had one target, emitted a private Direct edge, and described the continuation as RawInt. Native correctly found only a boxed captured closure and invoked its wrapper indirectly, so public ValueRef bits entered the falsely private RawInt continuation.

Data-model proof

The callee positioned TransportShape is the already-settled physical transport authority. ValueRef means a runtime callable value exists and must be invoked through its public wrapper. Absent means no runtime callable value exists and permits refinement to one exact semantic target. Target cardinality identifies a possible callee but cannot redefine its physical representation. CallableConstruction serves the separate purpose of constructing and packaging wrappers; reading it again for invocation would duplicate authority. The initial construction-owner strategy was disproven because it introduced generic owner reads and request-order-dependent interner identities without adding information that the carrier did not already state.

Strategy

Require TransportShape(Value(callee)) for every closure-call tail. Materialize ValueRef calls as indirect/public regardless of target count. Materialize Absent calls directly only with one exact target and fail loudly otherwise. Remove RuntimeDemand from this decision. For public non-tail delivery, name the caller-owned ReturnPayload as the source and the ResumePayload as the distinct destination.

Signal

The minimized structural regression proves one captured boundary, private RawInt member return, public ValueRef wrapper, indirect native closure call, ValueRef continuation, and interpreter/JIT result 42. Unit controls prove ValueRef plus multiple targets remains indirect and Absent plus multiple targets is rejected. Direct-only lambda and typed-capture controls remain direct; opaque and joined callable controls remain public. Request-order stability and byte-identical repeated backend publication pass. Full library tests, strict clippy, formatting, diff checks, release interp/run/build, and the original enum-reduce fixture all pass; no probes remain.
title: Preserve captured closure call results after first-class publication
